name: Cinecam
description: Nine cinematic free-camera shots, including a Dynamic camera with enemy-aware combat framing, full-circle collision avoidance with smooth wall recovery, teleport pursuit for AOTV-style jumps, speed-stabilized chase framing, and a full-frame mode. Open the studio with /freecam for a three-column editing desk with a live path monitor and tabbed controls. A separate manual mode layers WASD pan and wheel zoom over any shot. Local-player see-through keeps the subject readable behind occluding terrain. Client-side only.
